cases.situation: I paid for my friend Leo's Taylor Swift ticket 3 weeks ago, $186. He said he'd Venmo me 'this week' and hasn't. We're close and I don't want it weird.
cases.reply: Hey, whenever you're near your phone: $186 for the Eras ticket, I'm @maya-chen on Venmo. Just so it doesn't slip for either of us!
cases.note: The number, what it was for and how to pay. No story, no hint. He almost certainly forgot.

cases.situation: 去年借给大学同学小赵8000块，说好半年还，现在一年了他一直没提。我这两个月要交房租押金，确实需要这笔钱。
cases.reply: 小赵，跟你说个事哈：去年借你的那8000块，我这边11月初要交新房子的押金，想看看能不能在10月底前先还一部分？分两次也完全没问题，你看怎么方便，给我个大概时间就行。
cases.note: 数目、用途、截止时间都围绕自己的需要来说，不翻旧账也不评价对方，并主动给分期的台阶。

cases.situation: My friend Jade keeps asking me to book concert and brunch stuff on my card and then pays late or forgets. She just asked me to put the $140 festival tickets on my card again.
cases.reply: I can't front it this time, I'm keeping things tight this month. The presale opens Thursday at 10, want to both jump on at the same time and grab tickets next to each other?
cases.note: When it's a pattern, the fix is to stop fronting money, not a sharper reminder. Keep the plan, drop the float.

cases.situation: I reminded my friend Priya about the $64 she owes for her share of the Airbnb in Asheville and she replied 'wow, you're really chasing me over $64?' Not sure how to answer without it turning into a thing.
cases.reply: Ha, fair, it's not a lot, which is exactly why I'd like to get it off the list. My Venmo is @tess-marlow whenever you're ready. Looking forward to tacos on Saturday.
cases.note: When they get defensive, agree it's small, repeat the ask once and don't explain your finances. If it still doesn't come, decide whether to write it off for real.

cases.situation: 国庆和大学室友四个人去成都自驾，我订了民宿和租车，一共先垫了5,600。想在群里提前把怎么AA说清楚，别回来再算不清。
cases.reply: 来对个账～民宿3晚3,800，租车1,800，一共5,600，四个人每人1,400。大家出发前（10月1号前）微信转我就行。路上油费和过路费谁付谁记在群里，回来再一起算。
cases.note: Settling the split before the trip, with the number and a date, prevents most of the awkwardness afterwards.

cases.situation: 上个月找好朋友阿杰借了3,000块周转，说好9月底还。结果公司工资推迟到10月15号才发，这周还不上。他还没催我，我想主动跟他说。
cases.reply: 阿杰，那3,000块说好这周还你，但公司这个月工资推迟到10月15号发，我得晚两周。15号到账当天我就转给你。拖了真不好意思，要是你这几天急用，跟我说一声，我先想办法凑一部分给你。
cases.note: 欠钱的一方要在对方开口前主动说，给确定日期，并给对方说急需的空间。

cases.situation: My roommate Kai and I split utilities 50/50. The electric bill for August and September came to $236 and it came out of my account. I want to ask for his $118 and also suggest a setup so I'm not the one chasing every month.
cases.reply: Hey Kai, the electric bill for August and September came in at $236, so your half is $118. My Venmo's @ana-ruiz, anytime this week works. Going forward, want to both put $150 into a shared bills account on the 1st? Then neither of us has to chase the other.
cases.note: Number, what it was for and how to pay, then a system proposed up front, which prevents the next awkward reminder better than any wording.

cases.situation: I lent my friend Marco $200 back in April for a car repair. He just got laid off and I've decided I don't want the money back. I want to tell him so he stops feeling bad about it.
cases.reply: Hey Marco, about the $200 from April: please forget it, we're square. You've bailed me out more times than I can count, and you've got enough on your plate right now. Beers are on me Friday if you're up for it.
cases.note: Writing it off works only if you actually let it go: say it once, clearly, and never mention the amount again.
